meta.title: Workspace Cards
meta.description: Turns the sidebar workspace list into a grid of square cards, with the current workspace pinned above it. A Layout option in the section header switches between two views: workspaces first (cards stay, sessions float) and sessions first (sessions fill the sidebar, cards collapse into a bottom handle whose drawer jumps to a workspace's latest session). Card size, radius, icon, names and scrollbar are adjustable in Settings.
